description: MOCK ONLY catalogue of Track-B monitoring metrics accepted by POST /v1/monitoring/observations. These are placeholder monitoring quantities (heart rate, step count, oxygen saturation, sleep duration, blood-pressure slots). They are NOT derived from any dataset and no device integration exists; real wearable integrations remain PENDING (D-009 / P-6).
x-warning: Unit tokens are schema-local placeholders of the form u_<name>; no clinical unit is asserted anywhere in this repository before the data dictionary is ratified (Phase 0 §F-1).
x-track-rule: Track B is monitoring only. No metric in this catalogue may be used as a CAD-inference feature: wearable/monitoring payloads sent to POST /v1/predictions/cad-tabular are rejected with 422 wearable_input_not_valid_for_cad_inference (D-039, Phase 0 §F-4).
